title: Reverse spec decision record
description: Held decision that removes code-graph nodes from a reverse_spec denominator. Referenced by analysis-ledger.json dispositions[].decision_ref and checked by the analysis gate (check_reverse_spec_evidence --stage analysis).

decision.description: Must equal the disposition status that cites this record.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision (a person or the approving role), not the agent that proposed it.

affected_node_ids.description: Code-graph node ids this decision removes; every disposition citing the record must be listed.

approval_ref.description: Optional pointer to the approval (gate record, approval request id, PR review).
